mission.goal: Implement and locally verify a metadata-only private heartbeat API, a public OAuth 2.1 tool-only MCP gateway and a durable immutable storage interface around the existing VerifiedV4Authority without deploying or claiming live attachment.
mission.user: Kagiso Kim Mosiane as owner; bounded EvidenceOps heartbeat clients as authenticated metadata-only consumers
mission.workflow: an OAuth-authenticated MCP request is issuer/audience/scope checked; typed metadata is validated; the inbound token is discarded; a distinct Google service identity token targets the exact private API audience; the private API delegates policy, signing, acceptance and receipt decisions to VerifiedV4Authority; an immutable event append is exact-readback verified; a typed MCP result returns only metadata and proof fields
mission.data: pseudonymous owner, matter, mission, node, emitter, capability, key, correlation, event and transaction codes; classifications, enums, hashes, timestamps, counts, key fingerprints, complete signed lineages and signed receipts; raw prompts, messages, chats, documents, evidence, transcripts, legal content, personal data and credentials are prohibited
mission.interface: private typed HTTP heartbeat API plus public Streamable HTTP tool-only MCP gateway with Protected Resource Metadata, OAuth security schemes, standard search/fetch discovery and bounded heartbeat tools
mission.stack: Python 3.12 FastAPI service; existing standard-library verified-v4 heartbeat foundation; TypeScript on Node.js 22; Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK v1 production line; Express; standards-based JWT/JWKS validation; Google service-identity client; pluggable immutable event store
mission.environment: local repository and GitHub pull-request CI only for this mission; Google Cloud, Secret Manager, IAM, OAuth registration, Cloud Run revisions and traffic remain unmodified
mission.governance: Formation A1 permits one reversible code-and-test path only; VerifiedV4Authority remains the sole A0 runtime policy/signing authority; external and internal token audiences are separated; cloud effect, spend, registration, deployment and traffic changes require later permits and live readback
mission.failure: fail closed on forbidden raw fields, malformed metadata, missing configuration, OAuth issuer/signature/audience/expiry/scope failure, Cloud Run identity or internal-token failure, inbound token forwarding, timeout, partial write, changed replay, stale registration, forged or incomplete lineage, dependency failure, store readback mismatch, authority widening or false live-awareness claim
mission.testing: Python API unit and integration tests; TypeScript type, unit and gateway tests; exact audience/scope and no-token-passthrough failures; durable-store idempotency/conflict/readback tests; verified-v4 regressions; build, static security guards, MODISA contract validation and non-deploy workflow guard
mission.deployment: not authorized or performed; a future separately governed mission may attempt a zero-traffic canary only after exact identity, target, IAM, billing/quota, cost, secret, image, rollback and semantic-readback gates pass
mission.continuity: deterministic event and idempotency identities, immutable append semantics, exact readback, stop-generation fencing, bounded retry, structured metadata-only audit records, documented resume gates and exact prior-revision rollback design

assumptions.stack: Python 3.12 and Node.js 22 are CI authorities; the production MCP SDK stays on the documented v1 line while v2 remains pre-alpha
assumptions.runtime: the API and gateway run as separate services with separate identities; local tests use explicit fixture identities and never satisfy production readiness
assumptions.storage: the durable-store protocol supports immutable create-if-absent, identical replay, changed-replay conflict and exact readback; a Google Cloud Storage object-per-event binding is a later runtime configuration, not a current deployment claim
assumptions.authentication: external OAuth tokens target only the public MCP resource; internal Google service identity tokens target only the exact private API URL; the public token is never forwarded; named-secret defense in depth does not replace Cloud Run IAM
assumptions.deployment: no current authenticated deployment or IAM mutation path exists in this code-only permit; GitHub CI has read-only contents permission and contains no deploy trigger or cloud credential permission

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: tool-only MCP and JSON HTTP interfaces have no UI
components.backend: private FastAPI heartbeat adapter plus public TypeScript MCP gateway; both delegate policy outcomes to the existing VerifiedV4Authority and cannot create a second authority path
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: the activation contract uses an immutable event-store protocol, not a relational database
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: request/response activation has no dispatch queue; invocation does not imply provider delivery
components.worker: NOT_APPLICABLE: no background worker, unsolicited injection or per-chat heartbeat loop is implemented
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: existing inventory-only scheduler remains unchanged and gains no activation authority
components.cache: OAuth/JWKS implementations may use bounded standards-compliant key caching; authorization decisions are revalidated and no event body is cached
components.storage: typed immutable store interface with deterministic key, create-if-absent precondition, identical replay, changed-replay conflict, integrity digest, exact readback and explicit test-fixture versus production readiness separation
components.authentication: OAuth 2.1 Protected Resource Metadata, strict external issuer/signature/audience/expiry/scope verification, no token passthrough, distinct Google service identity token in X-Serverless-Authorization for the exact private audience, plus independently injected internal request secret

observability.correlation_ids: bounded caller correlation code plus deterministic event, envelope, receipt and idempotency hashes; raw request text is never a correlation field
observability.health_checks: minimal gateway liveness; private API health; fail-closed application readiness for non-fixture authority, internal auth, signer material, store health and external durability class; Cloud Run IAM enforcement and an immutable write/readback require separate provider canaries
observability.structured_logs: typed status, error code, route, scope, latency, count, timestamp and pseudonymous correlation hashes only
observability.audit_logs: authorization decision code, exact external and internal audience hashes, verified-v4 lineage/receipt identifiers, immutable append result and semantic readback digest without bearer tokens or raw content
observability.metrics_alerts: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: provider metrics, alert policies and notification transport are design-only future obligations; structured metadata-only logs provide the current local observation surface

testing.unit: metadata schema rejection, OAuth claims/scopes, audience separation, internal auth, deterministic identity, immutable append, replay, conflict, timeout and typed error mapping
testing.integration: MCP tool to authenticated private API contract using local fakes; API to injected VerifiedV4Authority and store; standard search/fetch shape; receipt and exact-readback behavior; no inbound token passthrough
testing.e2e_or_smoke: local process or in-memory synthetic gateway/API smoke only; it is not a hosted Cloud Run, provider, active-chat, emitter-coverage or live-attachment canary
testing.fixtures_mocks: synthetic metadata-only authority, OAuth claims/JWKS, Google identity-client boundary, internal secret and ephemeral store; every fixture is explicitly incapable of satisfying production readiness
testing.failure_first: raw-field rejection, bad issuer, bad external audience, bad internal audience, expired token, absent scope, forwarded token, wrong internal secret, stale/forged lineage, changed replay, store timeout, partial write and readback mismatch

delivery.file_tree: existing evidenceops/capability_heartbeat verified-v4 authority; evidenceops/heartbeat_api private service and tests; evidenceops-heartbeat-mcp public OAuth MCP gateway and tests; activation architecture, build contract and non-deploy CI workflow
test_commands: npm run check --prefix evidenceops-heartbeat-mcp && npm test --prefix evidenceops-heartbeat-mcp && npm run build --prefix evidenceops-heartbeat-mcp
deploy_commands: NOT_APPLICABLE: this contract and its CI workflow prohibit deployment, IAM mutation, secret mutation, cloud build and traffic changes
rollback_commands: Code-only rollback: revert only the activation API, gateway, activation governance files and non-deploy workflow; no cloud rollback exists because no cloud mutation is authorized or performed
Future canary design only: restore the exact recorded prior Cloud Run revision or traffic split, then perform health and semantic readback under a separate Formation permit
delivery.debugging: trace typed error and pseudonymous correlation codes across gateway, audience/scope decision, private identity gate, VerifiedV4Authority receipt and store digest/readback; never log or inspect raw content, bearer tokens, secret values or signer material

watchman.policy: fail closed; A0 verified-v4 authority only; metadata-only; distinct external and internal audiences; no token passthrough; no cloud effects; no deployment, active-chat coverage, provider emitter coverage or system-wide awareness claim
release_gates: exact Python and TypeScript tests pass

continuity.idempotency: the full canonical metadata payload, authority scope and control generation bind the event identity; identical replay is stable and changed replay fails closed
continuity.checkpoints: external OAuth claim decision, distinct internal audience decision, verified-v4 envelope/receipt, immutable append precondition result, exact store readback digest and typed MCP response
continuity.resume_conditions: current mission and permit; clean local test state; non-fixture runtime configuration for production; fresh registered signers; exact audience and scope configuration; reachable immutable store; active stop generation; later identity/IAM/cost/rollback proof before any canary
continuity.stop_switch: stop-generation advancement fences earlier state; disabling the public gateway or private service remains a later provider action requiring separate authority; current code can be removed without cloud side effects

proof.test_results: PASS_LOCAL_2026-08-02: the required activation lane passed 20/20 private API tests, 92/92 verified-v4 foundation tests and 18/18 Node.js MCP gateway tests (130 total), including 64 KiB request gating, signed key/event cross-binding, bounded indexed pagination, direct fetch, exact normalized HTTPS private audience equality, exact six-field semantic readback, OAuth issuer/signature/audience/expiry/scope failures and no inbound-token forwarding. TypeScript checking, production build and production-dependency audit with 0 vulnerabilities passed. An extended 30-test heartbeat integration suite and 81-test repository compatibility suite also passed, bringing the complete local regression count to 241. Activation JSON, generic MODISA 3.3 proof validation, workflow YAML parse, no-deploy guard, git diff check and public leak guard passed. Independent failure-first audit initially blocked release on four defects, all four were repaired and the repaired 40-file scope passed independent re-audit. No provider, deployment or container-image test was attempted.
proof.semantic_verification: Local tests verify typed metadata-only request handling, external OAuth checks, strict scope and audience separation, no inbound token passthrough, the application-internal secret boundary, verified-v4 delegation, immutable append/replay/conflict/readback semantics and truthful false deployment state; they do not verify Cloud Run IAM enforcement, a hosted provider route or a production write/readback canary
